items.source: Sets the locations of schema (DDL) scripts to apply to the database. By default, initialization will fail if a location does not exist. To prevent a failure, a location can be made optional by prefixing it with optional:.
items.translation: 设置要应用于数据库的架构（DDL）脚本的位置。默认情况下，如果位置不存在，初始化将失败。为防止失败，可以通过在位置前添加 optional:` 使其变为可选。

items.source: Sets the locations of data (DML) scripts to apply to the database. By default, initialization will fail if a location does not exist. To prevent a failure, a location can be made optional by prefixing it with optional:.
items.translation: 设置要应用于数据库的数据操作语言 (DML) 脚本的位置。默认情况下，如果位置不存在，初始化将失败。为防止失败，可以通过在位置前添加 optional:` 使其成为可选的。
